description: The article introduces a refinement of Japan's traditional three-tier examination taxonomy, retaining Types I (recall) and II (interpretation) but subdividing Type III into IIIa and IIIb.
title: Modified four-tier taxonomy for medical licensing examination items

description: The review applies a modified version of Painter et al.'s classification system to categorize how each CBI uses theory.
title: Modified Painter classification system for theory use in interventions (mentioned, applied, measured)
